name: KDG 61 (Hubble)
blurb: KDG 61, a dwarf spheroidal galaxy in the M81 group, seen by Hubble.
label: m81k61-hubble
story: One of the closest companions of the galaxy M81, this dwarf is the most luminous dwarf spheroidal in the M81 group. Some astronomers class it as a transition type, between a dwarf irregular and a dwarf spheroidal.

claims.text: KDG 61 is a dE/dSph member of the M81 group
KDG 61 is the most luminous dSph in the M81 group and one of the closest companions to M81
KDG 61 has been classified as a transitional type between dIrr and dSph
Hubble ACS images of KDG 61 come from proposal 9884
